entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE that performs cell measurement result sorting according to report configuration parameters.

entities.name: Report Configuration
entities.description: Configuration parameters associated with a measurement ID that triggers reporting and determines sorting quantity.

entities.name: Event Triggered Report Type
entities.description: Report type set to eventTriggered, which determines sorting quantity based on event-specific thresholds.

entities.name: Periodical Report Type
entities.description: Report type set to periodical, which determines sorting quantity based on report quantity configurations.

entities.name: Sorting Quantity
entities.description: The measurement quantity used to sort cell measurement results, determined by report configuration parameters.

entities.name: NR Cell
entities.description: New Radio cell for which sorting quantity is determined based on event thresholds or report quantities.

entities.name: E-UTRA Cell
entities.description: Evolved UTRA cell for which sorting quantity is determined based on bN-ThresholdEUTRA or reportQuantity.

entities.name: UTRA-FDD Cell
entities.description: UTRA Frequency Division Duplex cell for which sorting quantity is determined based on bN-ThresholdUTRA-FDD or reportQuantityUTRA-FDD.

entities.name: Candidate L2 U2N Relay UE
entities.description: Layer 2 UE-to-Network relay candidate UE for which sorting quantity is determined based on yN-Threshold2-Relay or reportQuantityRelay.

entities.name: Reference Signal Received Power
entities.description: RSRP measurement quantity used as sorting quantity when rsrp is set to true in periodical reporting.

entities.name: Reference Signal Received Quality
entities.description: RSRQ measurement quantity used as sorting quantity when rsrq is set to true in periodical reporting.

entities.name: Received Signal Code Power
entities.description: RSCP measurement quantity used as sorting quantity for UTRA-FDD cells in periodical reporting.

relations.description: UE determines sorting quantity according to report configuration parameters.
Sorting quantity is determined by parameters of the report configuration associated with the measurement ID.
For event triggered reporting, NR cell sorting quantity uses event-specific thresholds.
For event triggered reporting, E-UTRA cell sorting quantity uses bN-ThresholdEUTRA.
For event triggered reporting, UTRA-FDD cell sorting quantity uses bN-ThresholdUTRA-FDD.
For event triggered reporting, candidate L2 U2N Relay UE sorting quantity uses yN-Threshold2-Relay.
For periodical reporting, NR cell sorting quantity uses reportQuantityCell.
For periodical reporting, E-UTRA cell sorting quantity uses reportQuantity.
For periodical reporting, UTRA-FDD cell sorting quantity uses reportQuantityUTRA-FDD.
For periodical reporting, candidate L2 U2N Relay UE sorting quantity uses reportQuantityRelay.
For periodical reporting with rsrp set to true, RSRP is used as sorting quantity.
For periodical reporting with rsrq set to true, RSRQ is used as sorting quantity.
For periodical reporting of UTRA-FDD cells, RSCP is used as sorting quantity.
